title: MechanismHypothesis
description: MINIMAL Wave-1 representation of a fault-mechanism hypothesis. Explicitly NOT the deferred C5 hypothesis-DAG (FR-5): no graph, no dataflow edges; the family library remains K2 data. Governing inputs: S0_GOAL_ADR.md sections 2 and 8; FAULT_DISCOVERY_REQUIREMENTS.md FR-1..FR-3, FR-5, FR-7; WAVE1_CORPUS_MATRIX.md section 2 (two-part C1 separation). Authoritative goal (verbatim): 构建一个 Agent，能够从源代码中发现固件/软件故障机制，并推导出相应的故障检测/诊断规则。

hypothesis_id.description: Unique hypothesis identifier (e.g. H-C1-PAIRING-01). RULECARD_SCHEMA.json hypothesis_ref must point to a hypothesis whose status is promoted_to_rule.

fault_class.description: Fault family. Wave-1 families: condition_config_gated | init_submit_pairing | existence_absence | direct_flow_presence (S0_GOAL_ADR.md section 8). C1 (WAVE1_CORPUS_MATRIX.md section 2) uses init_submit_pairing.

mechanism_steps.description: Ordered causal steps of the mechanism; array order IS the mechanism order.

step_id.description: Step identifier within the hypothesis (e.g. S1, S2).

description.description: What this step asserts in the mechanism.

required_fact_ids.description: Fact IDs this step depends on. Every entry MUST appear as fact_id in required_facts, where the canonical factRef object (with the inherited trust_class) is carried.

step_kind.description: condition = conditional-structure fact; definition = symbol/definition fact; call_flow = proven call/reachability fact; config = build-config fact (Kconfig flag, -D flag, manifest); absence = enumerated absence fact (E4/E7 discipline).

required_facts.description: All FactRecords the mechanism depends on, as canonical factRef objects.

assumptions.description: Explicit assumptions the mechanism relies on but does not prove; each must be checkable by at least one refutation-protocol step of the derived RuleCard.

missing_evidence.description: Evidence gaps acknowledged by the hypothesis, including runtime-occurrence facts that source evidence cannot supply (two-part separation, WAVE1_CORPUS_MATRIX.md section 2).

why_needed.description: Which mechanism step or claim would change if this evidence were obtained.

channel.description: Channel expected to close the gap: one of the FACT_RECORD_SCHEMA.json evidence_surface values, or runtime_unavailable when no source channel can supply it (e.g. whether the work item is ever actually queued at runtime).

forbidden_overclaims.description: Claims this hypothesis must never assert (for C1 e.g.: queue full occurred; submission was lost at runtime; any resource-exhaustion claim). Carried into the promoted RuleCard's forbidden_overclaims (FR-7).

goal_item_ref.description: Goal item(s) cited under the authoritative goal (verbatim): 构建一个 Agent，能够从源代码中发现固件/软件故障机制，并推导出相应的故障检测/诊断规则。 Wave-1 cites goal items 1-3, never redefining them (S0_GOAL_ADR.md section 8).

corpus_ref.description: Corpus case identifier (C1/C4/C5/C6 per WAVE1_CORPUS_MATRIX.md section 3) or fixture identifier.

lineage.description: Repository lineage (A/B/C per WAVE1_CORPUS_MATRIX.md); single-variant only (GA-4 fence).

status.description: candidate = under development; rejected = refuted or withdrawn; insufficient_evidence = not establishable within declared scope (the hypothesis-side counterpart of a refutation_result INCONCLUSIVE lineage); promoted_to_rule = a RuleCard was derived from it.

factRef.description: Canonical reference to a FactRecord. This shape is IDENTICAL in FACT_RECORD_SCHEMA.json, MECHANISM_HYPOTHESIS_SCHEMA.json and RULECARD_SCHEMA.json; source of truth is FACT_RECORD_SCHEMA.json#/definitions/factRef.

fact_id.description: fact_id of the referenced FactRecord row in the immutable K1 fact log.

trust_class.description: Inherited-trust check: must equal the trust_class recorded in the fact log for fact_id. T1 refs are valid only as K1-mediated claims; T2 refs are never load-bearing (E2).
